config.title: Card Component

intro.title: Card Component
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable Card component in React with TypeScript. You'll learn how to structure a component to display content like a title, description, and an image in a clean, contained layout. The core concept is creating a functional component with typed props to ensure data consistency and reusability. You'll use JSX for the UI structure and TypeScript interfaces to define the component's props. By the end, you'll have a styled card that can be easily integrated into larger applications.
intro.usecase: Card components are a fundamental UI pattern used across modern web applications to display grouped information in a visually contained unit. You'll find them in e-commerce product listings, social media feeds showing posts, dashboard widgets displaying metrics, and news/article previews. As a React developer, you'll frequently build and customize card components to create consistent, reusable content containers that improve both user experience and code maintainability.

objectives: Construct a reusable Card component using TypeScript interfaces to define props
Implement conditional rendering logic to display optional content within the Card
Apply CSS styling to structure the Card layout with proper visual hierarchy
Initialize and manage component state to control interactive Card features
Bind event handlers to make the Card respond to user interactions
Configure the Card to accept and display dynamic content through props
Integrate the Card component within a parent component to demonstrate reusability
